Before we hit the road

A few good
questions.

Something else on your mind? Explore the dashboard to see how your delivery would work.

Take a look inside ↗
What can I move?

Furniture, appliances, boxed stock, business supplies and other permitted small to mid-size loads. Hazardous and prohibited items are excluded.

How does price negotiation work?

You propose a fare for your load and route. Carriers can accept or send a counter-offer. You can counter again, compare offers, then choose a carrier and confirm the agreed total. This prototype simulates responses and does not contact live carriers.

Where will the pilot operate?

The prototype uses Lagos–Ibadan as an example. The actual pilot corridor will be selected after research with shippers, receivers and carriers.

How are my goods and payments protected?

The planned service combines carrier verification, pickup and delivery codes, photo evidence and escrow through a licensed partner. Payment and insurance arrangements require validation before launch. No funds are collected in this prototype.

Can I book a delivery in advance?

Yes. Choose a future pickup date and time while creating the booking, then agree on a fare with carriers before confirming. Recurring bookings are planned for a later phase.

Is the service live yet?

This is an interactive product prototype. You can explore the booking flow and dashboard using demo data. Live carrier matching, payments and tracking are not connected.
